page.overview:
What is Agarthir?

Agarthir is a town located in the Babil Region of Grymoire in World of Final Fantasy. The town can be visited as early as Chapter 10, "Too Warm a Welcome", but it has no relevance to the story's plot until Chapter 21, "Chaos in Grymoire".

{|class="article-table WoFF full-width" style="text-align:center;"

!style="width:30%"|Items !style="width:30%"|Images !style="width:40%"|Location

The enemies in the corrupted version of Agarthir are encountered on the field, and can be fought only during Chapter 21 and the pre-ending Postscript.
